query: /pave-init turn porting meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct from vLLM to Cerebras CS-3 hardware into a workflow skill
setup: No live vLLM tree or CS-3 system is mounted; the goal is designable from documents and stated constraints. Expect Stage 1 to interview until the acceptance boundary (e.g. greedy parity on a golden prompt set) is explicit.
expected_behavior: Stage 1 produces requirements the user explicitly approves; the goal names the target system, the result, and the acceptance boundary before any planning starts
The root skeleton dispatch returns a decompose verdict with a falsifiable rationale; every framed child enters planning/frontier.yaml as pending, atomic predictions included
Each child's own planner dispatch re-judges the framing prediction and records confirm or overturn with a reason - a prediction is never treated as a verdict

planning/frontier.yaml passes scripts/validate_run_state.py --frontier at every queue state change: entries match $defs.frontier, each dispatch gets a freshly minted draft path, and a redispatch after a dead planner session never reuses the old path

Planner fragments reference the dispatched node's frozen contract via extensions.x_planning and never re-author it under nodes; the validator and the planning-layout warn hook stay silent on every conforming write
Planners report interface conflicts without resolving them and without minting c<N> ids; the lead registers each conflict in the frontier's conflicts register
A resynchronization that changes a frozen interface marks every reviewed dependent entry stale before anything else proceeds
No structure is mirrored from vLLM module boundaries without an independent sizing judgment; source behavior binds, source topology does not
Every check guarding an outcome's sole edge in the drafted graph declares an on_failure_route, and validate_pave.py passes the assembled draft before it is presented for approval
